pl_roost.advancement.root.title: Roost!
pl_roost.advancement.root.description: Use Feather, Stick, Egg to craft Chicken Wand at the Smithing Table
pl_roost.advancement.chicken_wand.title: Chicken Wand
pl_roost.advancement.chicken_wand.descri: Use the Chicken Wand to attack chickens, Then you can pick chicken up into inventory
pl_roost.advancement.chicken_soul.title: Chicken Soul
pl_roost.advancement.chicken_soul.descri: Be careful not to throw it out
pl_roost.advancement.roost.title: Roost?
pl_roost.advancement.roost.description: Place the Barrel on top of the Hay Block and Left-click the Hay Block with the Chicken Wand. Put the Chicken Soul in the Barrel to lay Eggs, and the more Chicken Souls, the faster the Eggs will be laid
